study.question: Can rank-eight learned history embeddings, retaining all full-resolution count summaries and width16 static embeddings, retain direct_lifted/shared_full utility with a reproducible end-to-end cost reduction? Does slicing the embedding weight before lookup help beyond the same representation with full-width event lookup?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: shared_full still executes four [B,L,16] history embeddings, a [B,L,64] field concatenation and width16 reductions although it also has rich discrete summaries. The long-history slice contains 3,026,583/3,234,051 validation exposures; this motivates inspecting event-width work, but no profiler establishes it as the dominant cost. Provisional mechanism: the full-resolution discrete summaries can supplement a lower-rank learned history path, while narrowing event lookups/reductions may lower memory traffic and arithmetic. Historical evidence is mixed: g2-r0024 action_pooled was near selected_exact (AUC0.63033749 versus0.63047240) without a clear cost benefit; g2-r0025 action_context0.62975154 and rotated_context0.62996342 trail shared_full0.63074234. Thus removing context resolution is not supported, and it is retained here. Shared_full used630.8601 training seconds and22.8507 inference seconds, versus selected_reference649.2562/23.8547; all are single-seed results. Frozen direct_lifted was0.63043168 AUC and0.19269404 logloss,676.1420/25.0225 seconds. These are observations, not controlled or repeated support for the proposed embedding mechanism. Missing Torch/raw data is an execution/input limitation, not counterevidence. All new outcomes are prospective.

nearest_work.difference: Nearest local parent. Retain shared pair/context counts and all inherited heads. Change only the embedding representation used in learned history pooling, factorized moments and global field contrasts; static fields stay full width. Parent is copied byte-for-byte as full_reference.py.

DIN documents embedding lookup, pooling/MLP and limited embedding dimension, then target-conditioned local activation. We inherit the general embedding/pooling family and existing target-match groups, not a new attention architecture. Rank reduction and fixed projections are generic; no priority or general novelty claim is made. The local proposal tests complementary full-resolution count summaries and narrow event execution in this frozen adapter. DIN original unnormalized activation is not claimed reproduced by the local softmax baseline.

Author README confirms category/brand/behavior inputs lack item identity. We preserve that boundary and describe pair buckets rather than items. Publisher full text is unavailable through this source, so no detailed DMR mechanism reproduction or priority comparison is asserted.

study.proposed_difference: Apply a fixed rank8 orthogonal projector to category, brand, action and log-age embeddings only when consumed by learned history features. Slice candidate reads weight[:, :8] directly using functional embedding and performs pooling at width8; zero-lift pooled vectors back to16 before inherited coordinatewise moments and norm transforms. Dense-slice control has identical representation but reads full-width event embeddings before slicing. Paired control averages the two eight-coordinate halves with1/sqrt(2), then uses the transpose lift after pooling. Its projector has the same rank and Frobenius norm as the slice projector. No claimed parameter-count reduction: 17,253,123 total,17,078,688 embedding and174,435 dense are inherited from the parent and must be confirmed by the host. Source symmetry of allocation does not equal equal functional capacity versus full16. Independent dense-event reconstruction oracle and unchanged-count checks run only as host diagnostics, outside timed forward.
predictions: Predeclared utility-retention margin: absolute AUC loss at most0.0005 and logloss increase at most0.0002 relative to contemporary full_reference; also report differences against frozen g1-r0020-direct_lifted0.6304316803980214/0.19269404064402526. To advance an efficiency claim both utility conditions must hold; full_reference itself must retain frozen utility. Use paired-seed mean differences and every seed result when repeated; no significance claim from one run.

Predeclared efficiency threshold: at least5% reduction in median host end-to-end training seconds or validation inference seconds versus repeated contemporary full_reference, with no greater than5% regression in the other, and report wall time, peak memory, parameter counts, throughput and p50/p95 latency under identical batch4096 conditions. A historical-only reduction is provisional. Tensor size reduction is a source fact, not a measured cost result.

compact_slice8 versus dense_slice8 should agree at the same checkpoint to1e-4 maximum feature and parent-logit discrepancy on the bounded host probe. Both share count outputs exactly up to inherited floating reductions (1e-5 tolerance). Any difference in predictive runs is numerical/optimization variation until repeated; these cells cannot establish a representation benefit.

dense_paired8 and dense_slice8 isolate two equal-rank replacements with identical allocated tables, dense event lookup and readout widths. Similar utility suggests slice orientation is not essential in this setting; disagreement narrows rather than establishes a general rank-sufficiency claim. Neither is claimed to preserve per-impression energy.

Host diagnostics should show rank8 projection/lift idempotence and norm preservation of the lift, commutation of linear pooling and projection, dense-event reconstruction agreement, unchanged identity/context/repeat/overlap inputs, masked-padding invariance, reordering invariance of main pooling features, and exact empty-history compatibility at the same checkpoint.

Keep existing predeclared history-length/hour/action/frequency slice boundaries and report sample/positive/negative counts. Slice comparisons are exploratory; large long-history degradation challenges utility retention even if aggregate is within margin. No new validation-derived slice threshold or test feedback is allowed.
falsifiers: An admitted candidate exceeding either utility-loss margin fails the proposed utility-retaining efficiency benefit, even if faster. One failed projector does not refute all lower-rank histories.

No repeated5% end-to-end cost reduction, or a greater than5% regression in the other main cost, fails the efficiency claim. In particular full-table SliceBackward accumulation and strided lookup overhead may outweigh smaller event intermediates.

Feature/oracle discrepancies above1e-4 or count differences above1e-5 invalidate intended implementation attribution; preserve receipts and repair only within remaining budget. Nonfinite logits/diagnostics or padding/empty-history failure is an implementation failure, not scientific evidence against rank compression.

A benefit confined to one seed, a weak historical reference, or parameter allocation without measured time does not establish reproducible efficiency. No observed gain is to be called a novel mechanism.
